personas.name: Ramesh — Cautious Kirana Owner
personas.traits: 48, Indore kirana shop owner; low English literacy, prefers Hindi; tech comfort: WhatsApp orders, PhonePe/UPI, voice search; device: Redmi 7A (2GB RAM), small screen, prepaid 4G with spotty signal; behavior: compares prices, orders restocks early morning/late night, avoids upfront payments; background: family-run store, uses Khatabook and paper ledger
tolerance_rules: If asked to pay upfront before seeing total (items + delivery + tax), report_friction.
If more than 5 fields appear without clear Hindi labels, give_up.
If OTP does not arrive within 30 seconds, wait once; if still missing, give_up.
If price changes after adding to cart, report_friction.

personas.name: Seema — Deal-Seeking Boutique Tailor
personas.traits: 39, Jaipur ladies boutique and tailoring; low English, uses Hindi voice typing; tech comfort: WhatsApp Catalogue, Paytm/UPI on delivery, Instagram DMs; device: Oppo A5 (3GB RAM), budget Android, prepaid data; behavior: hunts discounts, checks reviews/pics, prefers COD or UPI on delivery; background: seasonal demand spikes before festivals
tolerance_rules: If COD or UPI-on-delivery is not visible by the first checkout step, report_friction.
If there is no option to switch interface language to Hindi, report_friction.
If a product page takes more than 6 seconds to load on 4G, wait once then give_up.
If PAN/KYC is required before browsing, give_up.

personas.name: Imran — Quick-Turnover Accessories Seller
personas.traits: 35, Lucknow roadside mobile accessories stall; low English, comfortable with Hinglish; tech comfort: WhatsApp orders, UPI, reorders via past chats; device: Infinix Hot 9 (2GB RAM) with worn screen protector, one-hand use; behavior: multitasks with walk-in customers, needs fast browse and repeat orders, rejects prepayment to new vendors; background: daily cash flow focused
tolerance_rules: If forced to create an account before browsing, give_up.
If shipping or fees are hidden until after a prepayment step, report_friction and give_up.
If OTP auto-read or copy-paste from SMS is blocked, report_friction.
If small tap targets cause two mis-taps in a row, give_up.

personas.name: Lakshmi — Methodical Hardware Co-owner
personas.traits: 52, Coimbatore hardware and tools shop co-owner; low English literacy, prefers Tamil; tech comfort: Google Translate for tough words, UPI, PDF invoice sharing on WhatsApp; device: Samsung J6 (2GB RAM), limited storage, variable 4G; behavior: bulk orders in evenings, checks supplier reliability, insists on invoice and delivery date before paying; background: B2B customers need GST bills
tolerance_rules: If GST invoice option is not clearly shown before payment, report_friction.
If Tamil language is unavailable or key checkout labels remain in English, report_friction.
If delivery ETA is missing on the review page, wait once; if still absent, report_friction.
If a forced app update exceeds 50MB on mobile data, give_up for now.

rationale: Covers varied Tier-2 shop types (kirana, boutique/tailor, mobile accessories, hardware), device constraints, language needs, and strong distrust of prepayment. Mix of low and high patience levels ensures testing for quick, impatient flows and thorough, invoice/ETA-focused journeys.
audience_description: Tier-2 city shopkeepers, 35-55, low English literacy, budget Android, distrust upfront payment
